items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: “Cinnamon and Clove,” I’d just come back from Brazil and wanted to write in that idiom and that's what I wrote. And gave it to Alan and Marilyn and they just came up with, “Cinnamon and Clove,” which actually came from a Jorge Amado novel, a Brazilian, really great Brazilian novelist – a Brazilian writer, he wrote all kinds of things called… Gabriela, Cloves and Cinnamon [Gabriela, Cravo e Canela] which later on was made into a movie for which Jobim [Antonio Carlos Brasileiro de Almeida Jobim] wrote the music,…
